what: the lensing maps of M87* (Phase 1): COMPUTED in double precision, stored as half floats; a picture of the Kerr geometry, not a decided object. The only decided curve is Phase 0's (certs/bh-shadow.json); certs/bh-maps-check.json grades these maps against it
standing: COMPUTED (dashed in the WARRANT grammar). The spin is ASSUMED (each map one chosen value), the inclination ASSUMED (the camera fixed at 17°), the disk model ASSUMED

grid.axes: Bardeen's image plane in units of M, observer at infinity: α to the right, β up along the projected spin axis; λ = −α sin θo, η = (α² − a²) cos²θo + β²

camera.note: the operator's ruling: fixed at 17° (the jet's 17.2° ± 3.3°, Mertens et al. 2016); the EHT's 163° is the mirror image

views.note: Phase 2 (pre-registered 2026-10-31): leaving M87*'s 17° view, a picture of the model, not of M87*; the default spin only; cos and sin fixed doubles inside kerr.js's enclosures
Phase 2 (pre-registered 2026-10-31): leaving M87*'s 17° view, a picture of the model, not of M87*; the default spin only; cos and sin fixed doubles inside kerr.js's enclosures

spinNote: a = 47/50 = 0.94 is the CHOSEN default (the common GRMHD value 0.9375 is within 0.003; Phase 0 has enclosures at 0.94); a = 0 is Schwarzschild

layers.n = 0, 1, 2: the n-th crossing of the equatorial plane outside the horizon, counted backward from the observer (n = 0 the direct image, n = 1, 2 the first and second photon-ring images): r_s (M; +∞ for a crossing beyond 200 M on the way out), φ_s (rad in [0, 2π); φ = 0 the observer's azimuth, the near side; the prograde disk turns counter-clockwise in the image) and g = ν_obs/ν_emit
layers.fate: captured or escaped, and the crossing count

disk.velocity: prograde Keplerian circular orbits, Ω = 1/(r^{3/2} + a); g = 1/[u^t (1 − Ω λ)], u^t = (r^{3/2} + a)/(r^{3/4} √(r^{3/2} − 3 r^{1/2} + 2a))
disk.innerEdge: cut at the ISCO: g only where r_s ≥ the upper end of Phase 0's ISCO enclosure; inside it r_s and φ_s are kept, g is NaN (no plunging matter)
disk.emissionForPhase2: declared, not used by the maps: optically thin, every image adds; J(r) ∝ r⁻² on [r_isco, 20 M]; I_obs = Σ_n g_n³ J(r_n)

method.tracer: instruments/kerr/rays.js: Mino-time second-order system r'' = R′/2, u'' = G′/2 with φ alongside; Dormand–Prince 5(4), local tolerance 1e-12; crossings by re-stepping (Illinois); start at r = 200 M after the exact far leg (Gauss–Legendre in 1/r, the decoupled polar motion integrated from the observer); captured below r₊ + 1e-6; escaped outgoing past 200 M, with the remaining crossings counted from the polar motion
method.reproducible: only + − × ÷ and √ per ray: bit-identical on any IEEE-754 machine (re-traced on a sample in --check)
